# Zero-Lag - Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` then `CLAUDE.md` before suggesting changes. Both bind, and
this file adds nothing of its own, so the rules cannot drift apart.

- Project law: `CLAUDE.md`
- How to work: `AGENTS.md`
- Skills catalog: `.agent/master-skills.json`
- Quality bar: `.agent/quality-bar.json`

No secrets client-side. Authentication is not authorisation. Gates fail
closed. If a suggestion fights `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.md` wins.
